title: The retrieved craft may have been a living being

tellings.quote: itself could have been a living being

plain: John Blitch, a scientist who says he once worked with DARPA, the US military's research agency, spoke with podcast host Jesse Michels in 2025. Drawing on what a man named Jake Barber has said about a recovered unknown craft, Blitch suggests the craft itself "could have been a living being". If true, it would mean such craft are not just machines but alive in some way.
